1-sentence: Bref is single-crate (`bref`, GPUI 0.2.2) Markdown vault app with custom editor + dockable shell — reskin can keep all infra, only retoken/restructure chrome.
1. Framework/renderer/parser/state (as found):
- Framework: `Cargo.toml:11` `gpui 0.2.2`, `src/main.rs:1` routes `mcp` else `shell::run()`; `src/shell/mod.rs:372-406` opens window (`Client` decor, transparent, `dev.andrea.Bref`).
- Renderer: `src/shell/render.rs:14` `impl Render for Shell` (ground+sheets, panes, docks, palette, toasts); `src/views/editor/paint.rs`, `layout.rs:plan` (only damaged lines relaid); `src/views/editor/render.rs:8` page+footer/counts/format-bar.
- Parser: `src/logic/markdown/mod.rs:17` pure `Kind/link/headings/index/emphasis`, `tables.rs/lists.rs/front.rs/dates.rs/search.rs`; no replacement needed.
- State: `src/shell/mod.rs:Shell` owns `panes/groups/layout/nav/notes/prefs/theme`; `src/shell/pane.rs:Pane/Group`, `src/logic/layout.rs:Node` (Row/Col shares); `src/views/*` are GPUI entities talking via `EditorEvent/SheetEvent/CanvasEvent`; pure `src/logic/`, I/O `src/platform/`, shared `src/ui/`, `src/lang.rs:tr()`.
2. Reusable for 3-region + theming:
- `src/ui/theme.rs:Theme::of/THEMES/Page::measure`: centralized tokens (bg/text/soft/accent/panel/border/ground/selection/hover) + WCAG `legible/contrast` tests, `Page::{Narrow 560/Normal 720/Wide 960}` — extend to light/dark/sepia + Inter/JetBrains tokens here.
- `src/views/nav.rs:RAIL/ROW/LIST_W/GAP/Mode/Panel::{Rail,Split,Full}` + `src/shell/sidebar.rs`, `docks.rs:dock_tools/put_tool/left_open/right_open`, `render.rs:render_nav/render_right_dock` — already independently toggleable left/right docks; add right-outline as `Mode`/dock.
- `src/shell/palette_open.rs:32 open_outline` (`markdown::headings`), `src/views/editor/render.rs:counts()` footer — reuse for outline panel + stats.
- `src/ui/assets.rs:FONT_FILES/FAMILIES/sans/mono` (bundled IBM Plex OFL) — pattern for bundling Inter+JetBrains Mono + licences in `assets/fonts/`.
3. Docs load/edit/save: `src/platform/vault.rs:load_config/scan/notify-watcher+timer/index(tags/links/lower)`; `src/shell/notes.rs:load_note` (`fs::read_to_string`→Editor, image/table/diagram branch, `set_file`); typing→`EditorEvent::Changed`→`dirty=true`, 400ms debounce `save_gen`→`flush_one:391`→`take_outside` (`src/logic/merge.rs` 3-way) + `vault::save` atomic/no-overwrite + H1-rename, graph/recent/history update; undo in `src/views/editor/edit.rs`.
4. Platform: Linux CSD — app draws pill/frame/shadow/resize (`render.rs:64-84,SHADOW/PILL_ROOM/frame_radius/frame_shadow`); macOS/Windows `Decorations::Server` native bar (`shell/mod.rs:397-401`); bundle `packaging/macos/Info.plist+Bref.icns`, `dev.andrea.Bref.desktop`; keep `window_background:Transparent+client_inset`, `min 360x240`; sepia must pass existing `theme.rs` contrast tests.
5. Phase 1 plan (foundation only, no editor/infra rewrite):
- (a) Document-canvas-first: touch `ui/theme.rs` (tokens+sepia+Inter/Mono prefs), `ui/assets.rs`, `views/editor/style.rs/render.rs` (16px/1.7, H1 30/H2 23/H3 19, 800px measure, hide permanent bar). Risk: low (isolated), but shell still IDE-like; needs follow-up.
- (b) Full-3-region-shell-first: (a) + `shell/render.rs/mod.rs` (3-region flex, toggleable, small-screen→doc-first), `shell/sidebar.rs+docks.rs+views/nav.rs` (left explorer/nav/search/settings, right outline `Mode::Outline` from `headings()`), `shell/keymap.rs+actions.rs` shortcuts, `logic/prefs.rs+layout` persist toggles. Risk: medium — layout/drag/focus regressions (`pane_drag/tool_aim/crowded/MIN_PANE`), test churn in `shell/tests/`; wins Typora structure day-1.
Open Q: branch not verified (no shell allowed — caller check `git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD`); confirm target fonts licences + sepia contrast bar; outline-as-dock vs new view?; keep tabs/splits in Phase 1?
